interventions.what: text screen and BIOS data area (0040:0049, 0040:006C) read from DOSBox-X savestates (Host+S; components Vga and Memory)
a savestate is written at each read, and one is loaded (Host+L) at the start and at the reset (save and load of emulator state; neutrality not tested)

start_state.restore: fresh DOSBox-X process (config sha256 0be736ab84ee79f9fae8d4f2c77224a6d5b0d59b872dab403fe9cc9fe0635c58) with C: mounted from the folder the savestate was made with, recreated from the verified copy of One-Nil 96 (records/T01/inventory.json); 1-0 run to its title screen; key n to change the screen; then Host+L (the emulator's load key: F12+L before issue 244, Print Screen alone since; see driver.py) loads the savestate whose sha256 is given; polled until the screen digest equals the one stored with it (bd2633ced0d7d0e307c4ed14cc0ed1c9d796a872d184d2ba4289cebf94fcbbe5); host clock and seed not controlled
